title: Forest Japanese Rock Plain Stone Small 12
description:
The ‘Forest Japanese’ themed assets capture the dense, humid character of subtropical woodland environments. Featuring high-fidelity scans of moss-covered rock ledges and clusters, twisted tree trunks and branches, hanging vines, fallen fruit, and scattered forest debris, this collection reflects the layered undergrowth and constant decay of a living forest floor.
Ideal for creating dense, immersive forest environments with a strong sense of scale, natural variation, and environmental storytelling.
